item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
A wall of silence enabled child sexual abuse to continue for generations in the OALC church.

But because of survivors like Kyla Chamberlin, we were able to tell their stories — and help break down that wall.

Listen to the latest “Paper Trail” episode: https://propub.li/3Uax2SK
